verses.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.pt: Então os cabeças das casas paternas dos levitas chegaram a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e a Josué, filho de Num, e aos cabeças das casas paternas nas tribos dos filhos de Israel,
verses.en_web: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Then the heads of the families of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun, and to the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel;

verses.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
verses.pt: em Siló, na terra de Canaã, e lhes falaram, dizendo: O Senhor ordenou, por intermédio de Moisés, que se nos dessem cidades em que habitássemos, e os seus arrabaldes para os nossos animais.
verses.en_web: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for our livestock.”
verses.en_bbe: And said to them in Shiloh in the land of Canaan, The Lord gave orders by Moses that we were to have towns for living in, with their grass-lands for our cattle.

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
verses.pt: Pelo que os filhos de Israel deram aos levitas, da sua herança, conforme a ordem do Senhor, as seguintes cidades e seus arrabaldes.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel out of their heritage gave to the Levites these towns with their grass-lands, by the order of the Lord.

verses.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.pt: Saiu, pois, a sorte às famílias dos coatitas; e aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, que eram dos levitas, caíram por sorte, da tribo de Judá, da tribo de Simeão e da tribo de Benjamim, treze cidades;
verses.en_web: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: And the heritage came out for the families of the Kohathites: the children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, were given thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

verses.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.pt: aos outros filhos de Coate caíram por sorte, das famílias da tribo de Efraim, da tribo de Dã e da meia tribo de Manassés, dez cidades;
verses.en_web: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.en_bbe: The rest of the children of Kohath by their families were given ten towns from the tribes of Ephraim and Dan and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.pt: aos filhos de Gérson caíram por sorte, das famílias da tribo de Issacar, da tribo de Aser, da tribo de Naftali e da meia tribo de Manassés em Basã, treze cidades;
verses.en_web: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.en_bbe: The children of Gershon by their families were given thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar and Asher and Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh which was in Bashan.

verses.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.pt: e aos filhos de Merári, segundo as suas familias, da tribo de Rúben, da tribo de Gade e da tribo de Zebulom, doze cidades.
verses.en_web: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.en_bbe: The children of Merari by their families were given twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben and Gad and Zebulun.

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.pt: Assim deram os filhos de Israel aos levitas estas cidades e seus arrabaldes por sorte, como o Senhor ordenara por intermédio de Moisés.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel gave these cities with their suburbs by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.
verses.en_bbe: All these towns with their grass-lands the children of Israel gave by the decision of the Lord to the Levites, as the Lord had given orders by Moses.

verses.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
verses.pt: Ora, deram, da tribo dos filhos de Judá e da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, estas cidades que por nome vão aqui mencionadas,
verses.en_web: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
verses.en_bbe: From the tribes of the children of Judah and the children of Simeon they gave these towns, listed here by name:

verses.en: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
verses.pt: as quais passaram a pertencer aos filhos de Arão, sendo estes das famílias dos coatitas e estes, por sua vez, dos filhos de Levi; porquanto lhes caiu a primeira sorte.
verses.en_web: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
verses.en_bbe: These were for the children of Aaron among the families of the Kohathites, of the children of Levi: for they came first in the distribution.

verses.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.pt: Assim lhes deram Quiriate-Arba, que é Hebrom, na região montanhosa de Judá, e seus arrabaldes em redor (Arba era o pai de Anaque).
verses.en_web: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its suburbs around it.
verses.en_bbe: They gave them Kiriath-arba, the town of Arba, the father of Anak, (which is Hebron) in the hill-country of Judah, with its grass-lands.

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.pt: Mas deram o campo da cidade e suas aldeias a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, por sua possessão.
verses.en_web: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.en_bbe: But the open country round the town, and its unwalled places, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as his property.

verses.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
verses.pt: Aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, deram Hebrom, cidade de refúgio do homicida, e seus arrabaldes, Libna e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And to the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Libnah with its grass-lands;

verses.en: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
verses.pt: Jatir e seus arrabaldes, Estemoa e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Jattir with its suburbs, Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And Jattir with its grass-lands, and Eshtemoa with its grass-lands;

verses.en: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
verses.pt: Holom e seus arrabaldes, Debir e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Holon with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And Holon with its grass-lands, and Debir with its grass-lands;

verses.en: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.pt: Aim e seus arrabaldes, Jutá e seus arrabaldes, Bete-Semes e seus arrabaldes; nove cidades dessas duas tribos.
verses.en_web: Ain with its suburbs, Juttah with its suburbs, and Beth Shemesh with its suburbs: nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.en_bbe: And Ain, and Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, with their grass-lands; nine towns from those two tribes.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Benjamim, Gibeão e seus arrabaldes, Geba e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its suburbs, Geba with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave Gibeon and Geba with their grass-lands;

verses.en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Anatote e seus arrabaldes, Almom e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Anathoth with its suburbs, and Almon with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: Anathoth and Almon with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.pt: Todas as cidades dos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, foram treze cidades e seus arrabaldes.
verses.en_web: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: Thirteen towns with their grass-lands were given to the children of Aaron, the priests.

verses.en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.pt: As famílias dos filhos de Coate, levitas, isto é, os demais filhos de Coate, receberam as cidades da sua sorte; da tribo de Efraim
verses.en_web: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.en_bbe: The rest of the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, were given towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.pt: deram-lhes Siquém, cidade de refúgio do homicida, e seus arrabaldes, na região montanhosa de Efraim, Gezer e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: They gave them Shechem with its suburbs in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And they gave them Shechem with its grass-lands in the hill-country of Ephraim, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Gezer with its grass-lands;

verses.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Quibzaim e seus arrabaldes, Bete-Horom e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Kibzaim with its suburbs, and Beth Horon with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: And Kibzaim and Beth-horon with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Dã, Elteque e seus arrabaldes, Gibetom e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its suburbs, Gibbethon with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Dan, Elteke and Gibbethon with their grass-lands;

verses.en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Aijalom e seus arrabaldes, Gate-Rimon e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Aijalon with its suburbs, Gath Rimmon with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: Aijalon and Gath-rimmon with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.pt: E da meia tribo de Manassés, Taanaque e seus arrabaldes, e Gate-Rimon e seus arrabaldes; duas cidades.
verses.en_web: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its suburbs, and Gath Rimmon with its suburbs: two cities.
verses.en_bbe: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach and Gath-rimmon with their grass-lands, two towns.

verses.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.pt: As famílias dos demais filhos de Coate tiveram ao todo dez cidades e seus arrabaldes.
verses.en_web: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: All the towns of the rest of the families of the children of Kohath were ten with their grass-lands.

verses.en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.pt: Aos filhos de Gérsom das famílias dos levitas, deram, da meia tribo de Manassés, Golã, cidade de refúgio do homicida, em Basã, e seus arrabaldes, e Beesterá e seus arrabaldes; duas cidades.
verses.en_web: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its suburbs: two cities.
verses.en_bbe: And to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, they gave from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Ashtaroth with its grass-lands, two towns.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Issacar, Quisiom e seus arrabaldes, Daberate e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion and Daberath with their grass-lands;

verses.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Jarmute e seus arrabaldes, En-Ganim e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Jarmuth with its suburbs, En Gannim with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: Jarmuth and En-gannim with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Aser, Misal e seus arrabaldes, Abdom e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its suburbs, Abdon with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Asher, Mishal and Abdon, with their grass-lands:

verses.en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Helcate e seus arrabaldes, Reobe e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Helkath with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: Helkath and Rehob with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
verses.pt: E da tribo de Naftali, Quedes, cidade de refúgio do homicida, na Galiléia, e seus arrabaldes, Hamote-Dor e seus arrabaldes, Cartã e seus arrabaldes; três cidades.
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its suburbs, and Kartan with its suburbs: three cities.
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Hammoth-dor and Kartan with their grass-lands, three towns.

verses.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.pt: Todas as cidades dos gersonitas, segundo as suas famílias, foram treze cidades e seus arrabaldes.
verses.en_web: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: All the towns of the Gershonites with their families were thirteen with their grass-lands.

verses.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
verses.pt: Âs famílias dos filhos de Merári, aos demais levitas, deram da tribo de Zebulom, Jocneão e seus arrabaldes, Cartá e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its suburbs, Kartah with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And to the rest of the Levites, that is, the families of the children of Merari, they gave from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam and Kartah with their grass-lands;

verses.en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Dimna e seus arrabaldes, Naalal e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Dimnah with its suburbs, and Nahalal with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: Dimnah and Nahalal with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Rúben, Bezer e seus arrabaldes, Jaza e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its suburbs, Jahaz with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and Jahaz with their grass-lands;

verses.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.pt: Quedemote e seus arrabaldes, Mefaate e seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs: four cities.
verses.en_bbe: Kedemoth and Mephaath with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Gade, Ramote, cidade de refúgio do homicida, em Gileade, e seus arrabaldes, Maanaim e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Mahanaim with their grass-lands;

verses.en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
verses.pt: Hesbom e seus arrabaldes, Jazer e seus arrabaldes; ao todo, quatro cidades.
verses.en_web: Heshbon with its suburbs, Jazer with its suburbs: four cities in all.
verses.en_bbe: Heshbon and Jazer with their grass-lands, four towns.

verses.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.pt: Todas essas cidades couberam por sorte aos filhos de Merári, segundo as suas famílias, o restante das familias dos levitas; foram, ao todo, doze cidades.
verses.en_web: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
verses.en_bbe: All these towns were given to the children of Merari by their families, that is, the rest of the families of the Levites; and their heritage was twelve towns.

verses.en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.pt: Todas as cidades dos levitas, no meio da herança dos filhos de Israel, foram quarenta e oito cidades e seus arrabaldes.
verses.en_web: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: All the towns of the Levites, among the heritage of the children of Israel, were forty-eight towns with their grass-lands.

verses.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.pt: Cada uma dessas cidades tinha os seus arrabaldes em redor; assim foi com todas elas.
verses.en_web: Each of these cities included their suburbs around them. It was this way with all these cities.
verses.en_bbe: Every one of these towns had grass-lands round it.

verses.en: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.pt: Desta maneira deu o Senhor a Israel toda a terra que, com juramento, prometera dar a seus pais; e eles a possuíram e habitaram nela.
verses.en_web: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land which he gave by oath to their fathers; so it became their heritage and their living-place.

verses.en: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.pt: E o Senhor lhes deu repouso de todos os lados, conforme tudo quanto jurara a seus pais; nenhum de todos os seus inimigos pôde ficar de pé diante deles, mas a todos o Senhor lhes entregou nas mãos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave them peace on every side, as he had said to their fathers: all those who were against them gave way before them, for the Lord gave them all up into their hands.

verses.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.pt: Palavra alguma falhou de todas as boas coisas que o Senhor prometera à casa de Israel; tudo se cumpriu.
verses.en_web: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord kept faith with the house of Israel about all the good which he said he would do for them, and all his words came true.
